mood: A softly lit landscape museum gallery: two unequal gold frame fragments join around open ivory wall, carrying a rainy street into a nested picture. Two rear-view visitors gather at their shared edge above empty tiled floor. A branching orange-red-and-white stair is the second large feature; a patterned textile return, printed paper reveal, curled woven hanging and small peaked relief remain subordinate.
material_language: Matte ivory and green-gray plaster, pale tiled floor and shallow cornice shadows
Warm beaded gold frame ridges beside softly grained pictorial surfaces
Yellow-patterned dark cloth and coarse tan-brown woven strips
Grainy black, blue, teal and yellow printing on cream paper
lighting: Diffuse gallery daylight; warm glints on gold beads, soft floor shadows and deeper shadows between curled strips. No theatrical spotlighting.
object_inventory: A branching stair carries orange-red and white bands across its risers.
Unequal beaded gold street-picture fragments face two rear-view visitors.
A dark cloth return shifts from yellow foliage to stripes to white motifs.
A cream paper reveal bears black foliage and blue, teal and yellow drops.
Coarse tan-brown strips curl apart into uneven ends and deep wall shadows.
A dark peaked relief has blue rays and tiny monochrome raised-arm figures.
negative_constraints: No centered intact painting with symmetrical side bays; no complete original gallery lineup or near-identical source arrangement.
No abstract substitutes for the two visitors, street motifs or picture-and-viewer relationship; no diagrammatic section centerpiece.
No pasted source photos, screenshots, cards, labels, legible text, logos or page chrome.
No target rings, pins, numbered symbols, debug marks, bounds or polygons.
No portrait or panoramic reformatting; do not enclose the entire gallery in a framed panel.
No identifiable facial likenesses, invented historical motifs or claims that these separate works originally occupied one gallery.
